<STBG 3,0><TALK 1><NAME 1><BGM 0,0,502><CHAR 5,1,6,0,0><CHAR 1,1,1,2,0><CV 1,5>Dr. Sharon!
I found a crystal I've never seen,
so I came to report it!
<TALK 5><NAME 12><CV 4,2>Good of you to come. Let me see!

What is it...?
I can hear a sound from the crystal!

Like a human voice...
Could that voice from the cave be...

That's it.
This voice was echoing in the cave.

A singing crystal, one might call it...
Anyway, this is a new discovery!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,10><CHAR 1,0,1,3,0>We did it, Hunter!
A great discovery!
